description: This file implements geospatial commands for Redis, including geoadd, georadius, georadiusbymember, geohash, geopos, and geodist, with helper functions for geohash decoding, range queries, and shape-based filtering.

methods.name: geoArrayCreate
methods.description: Creates a new geoArray structure for storing geospatial points.

methods.name: geoArrayAppend
methods.description: Appends a new geoPoint to the geoArray.

methods.name: geoArrayFree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a geoArray.

methods.name: decodeGeohash
methods.description: Decodes a geohash bits value into latitude and longitude.

methods.name: extractLongLatOrReply
methods.description: Extracts longitude and latitude from command arguments, replying with error on failure.

methods.name: longLatFromMember
methods.description: Decodes latitude and longitude from a zset member score.

methods.name: extractUnitOrReply
methods.description: Returns conversion factor for distance units, or error if unsupported.

methods.name: extractDistanceOrReply
methods.description: Extracts distance and unit from arguments, converting to meters.

methods.name: extractBoxOrReply
methods.description: Extracts width, height, and unit for box shape, converting to meters.

methods.name: addReplyDoubleDistance
methods.description: Replies with a distance value formatted with 4 decimal places.

methods.name: geoWithinShape
methods.description: Checks if a point is within a specified shape (circle or rectangle).

methods.name: geoGetPointsInRange
methods.description: Retrieves points within a specified range from a sorted set, applying shape filtering.

methods.name: scoresOfGeoHashBox
methods.description: Calculates min and max scores for a geohash box for range queries.

methods.name: membersOfGeoHashBox
methods.description: Retrieves members within a geohash box.

methods.name: membersOfAllNeighbors
methods.description: Retrieves members from neighboring geohash boxes for radius search.

methods.name: sort_gp_asc
methods.description: Comparator for sorting geoPoints in ascending order by distance.

methods.name: sort_gp_desc
methods.description: Comparator for sorting geoPoints in descending order by distance.

methods.name: geoaddCommand
methods.description: Implements the GEOADD command to add geospatial points to a sorted set.

methods.name: georadiusGeneric
methods.description: Core implementation for georadius, georadiusbymember, and related commands with shape and optional parameters.

methods.name: georadiusCommand
methods.description: Wrapper for georadius command.

methods.name: georadiusbymemberCommand
methods.description: Wrapper for georadiusbymember command.

methods.name: georadiusroCommand
methods.description: Wrapper for radius command with no store.

methods.name: georadiusbymemberroCommand
methods.description: Wrapper for radius by member command with no store.

methods.name: geosearchCommand
methods.description: Implements GEOSEARCH command.

methods.name: geosearchstoreCommand
methods.description: Implements GEOSEARCHSTORE command.

methods.name: geohashCommand
methods.description: Returns geohash strings for specified elements.

methods.name: geoposCommand
methods.description: Returns longitude and latitude for specified elements.

methods.name: geodistCommand
methods.description: Calculates distance between two elements.
